House of Lusignan.fact: The House of Lusignan ( LOO-zin-yon; French: [lyziɲɑ̃]) was a royal house of French origin, which at various times ruled several principalities in Europe and the Levant, including the kingdoms of Jerusalem, Cyprus, and Armenian Cilicia, from the 12th through the 15th centuries during the Middle Ages. Interior (topology).fact: In mathematics, specifically in topology, the interior of a subset S of a topological space X is the union of all subsets of S that are open in X. The exterior of a set S is the complement of the closure of S; it consists of the points that are in neither the set nor its boundary.
